Mat’s got his hands on the all-new Mercedes C-Class Electric! 

It’s the first time the C-Class has gone electric, and he’s about to test it over in Helsinki and see just what it’s like to drive. Not only that, he’ll be seeing if it offers real value against class-leading competitors like the Tesla Model 3. 

So can this all-new EV compete with the best? Let’s take a closer look…

In terms of design, the new C-Class Electric uses three-pointed-star headlights and taillights, as seen in all recent Mercedes reveals. The car we have here is in AMG-Line trim, which means it comes with large front vents and lower front and rear bumpers.
